title: Consistent multi-signal attribution
briefing: A newly observed persona on CipherDen reuses a known alias, a known PGP key and a known wallet identifier, and was observed on a server already associated with a catalogued actor. All evidence families are present.

title: Deceptive / conflicting financial evidence
briefing: Persona, writing style, activity rhythm and infrastructure all point toward one actor, but the financial identifier attached to the persona belongs to a different catalogued actor. No PGP material was recovered.

title: Sparse evidence / insufficient corroboration
briefing: Only three short posts and a handful of activity events were recovered. No infrastructure, PGP or financial evidence is available, and one post predates the recorded account creation date.
